sources.entry: Collabora Online Development Edition - Collabora Online Development Edition (CODE) is a powerful LibreOffice-based online office that supports all major document, spreadsheet and presentation file formats, which you can integrate in your own infrastructure. (Source Code) MPL-2.0 C++

summary.name: Collabora Online Development Edition (CODE)
summary.one_liner: Collabora Online Development Edition (CODE) is a LibreOffice-based online office suite that can be integrated into your own infrastructure.
use_cases: integrate office editing into own platform
summary.what_it_does: The page is a Gerrit/Gitiles source repository view for the Collabora Online project, which is the source behind Collabora Online Development Edition (CODE). According to the listing text, CODE is a LibreOffice-based online office that supports all major document, spreadsheet and presentation file formats. It is meant to be integrated into your own infrastructure. The licence is listed as MPL-2.0 and the main language as C++. The page text itself is mostly sign-in and navigation content, so no further features are confirmed here.
notable: Based on LibreOffice, so it uses LibreOffice's document engine
Supports all major document, spreadsheet and presentation formats (per listing)
Designed to be integrated into your own infrastructure
Source under MPL-2.0 licence, written in C++
caveats: Page text is mostly sign-in and navigation; capabilities come from the awesome-selfhosted listing, not the page itself
Hosting and integration are left to the user
